gate.text: Tickets please! Everything sparkles twice today.

ride.zu_teuer: Not enough coins. The booth stays firm, but friendly.
ride.zu_muede: Gooby is too tired for this ride. Rest first!
ride.laeuft: On its way — the train will be right back.

coaster.name: Sparkle Loop
coaster.beschreibung: Chain lift, big drop, loop — Gooby rides up front.
coaster.board: All aboard! Gooby hops into the front cart.
coaster.done: What a ride! Gooby is still wobbly.
coaster.photo_saved: Ride photo saved to the gallery!

wheel.name: Giant Wheel
wheel.beschreibung: A gentle spin high above Sparkle Park.
wheel.board: Gooby snuggles into a pastel gondola.
wheel.apex: The very top! Gooby waves at the whole park.
wheel.done: Back down — what a lovely view that was.
wheel.photo_saved: View photo saved to the gallery!

karussell.name: Sparkle Carousel
karussell.beschreibung: Round after round on colorful ponies.
karussell.done: Ahh, that was a lovely spin.

scooter.name: Bumper Cars
scooter.beschreibung: The little cars nudge each other — Gooby watches, giggling.
scooter.hint: Watching only today: Gooby's paws can't reach the pedal.

alley.title: Candy Alley
alley.hint: Fair treats! Snacks land in Gooby's food tray.

cottonCandy.name: Sugar Cloud
cottonCandy.pitch: A pink cloud on a stick — pure fair magic.

softServe.name: Swirl Stop
softServe.pitch: A creamy swirl with a cone hat.

waffle.name: Waffle Wonder
waffle.pitch: Fresh off the iron, golden and warm.

nacht.lichter: The lights come on — now the park really sparkles.
